const both = [alpha.twice, beta.twice]
Function show {
  /say ${alpha.twice} ${both} ${beta.tag}
}
const missing = alpha.thrice

-- b.mms --
Namespace other
Blueprint Pair {
  v: int
  emit {
    const twice: int = v * 2
    const tag = "${self.id}"
    Objective ${self.path}: dummy
  }
}
Pair alpha { v = 3 }
Pair beta { v = alpha.twice }
